en.t: "Oh, that woman? She has already married."

units.source_text: 他简单地回答道，"我详尽地教给她一种掩饰非处女的方法，

en.t: He answered simply, "I taught her in detail a way to hide the fact that she was not a virgin,

units.source_text: 不过她丈夫是个老实人，大概可以顺利地对付过去吧。"

en.t: but her husband is an honest man, so she can probably get through it without trouble."
